description: Today's morning brief — the daily synthesized narrative of what moved across the information environment and what to watch, from the engine's cross-domain analysis. Same content as the public /today page. Carries `gaps` (where prediction-market money and the day's coverage disagree) and `watch` (what would change the story); every market figure in either arrives with the contract URL behind it, or the figure is withheld and the row says so.
name: todays_brief
